rules.title: Loan existence and status check
rules.statement: Raises LMS-001 if loan row not found; raises LMS-021 if status is not ACTIVE.

rules.title: Quote date validation
rules.statement: Raises LMS-002 if p_quote_date is before v_loan.disb_date.

rules.title: Principal outstanding amount
rules.notes: Handles missing outstanding value by falling back to disbursed.

rules.title: Interest rate selection
rules.statement: If rate_type=FIXED uses fixed_rate_pct; else uses latest benchmark_rate.rate_pct on or before quote_date plus spread_pct (coalesce to 0 if either missing).
rules.notes: Benchmark lookup returns 0 when no row matches.

rules.title: Accrued interest calculation
rules.statement: Computes v_days as greatest(p_quote_date - coalesce(last_run_date, disb_date), 0); adds round(o_principal * v_rate / 100 * v_days / (365 if day_count=ACT365 else 360), 2) to v_loan.accrued_interest.
rules.notes: Single rounding to 2 decimals; missing day_count treated as 360.

rules.title: Penal interest and fees passthrough
rules.statement: o_penal set to v_loan.accrued_penal; o_fees set to v_loan.fees_outstanding.

rules.title: Prepayment fee eligibility and amount
rules.statement: v_left computed via extract(year/month from age(p_quote_date, disb_date)); if rate_type=FIXED and prepay_fee_pct not null and v_left > 3 then o_prepay_fee = round(o_principal * prepay_fee_pct / 100, 2) else 0.
rules.notes: Uses age() for month difference; rounding to 2 decimals declared.

rules.title: Total payoff amount
rules.statement: o_total = greatest(o_principal + o_interest + o_penal + o_fees + o_prepay_fee + o_gst - v_loan.advance_balance, 0).
rules.notes: Advance balance subtracted; floor at zero.

rules.title: Quote validity period
rules.statement: o_valid_until set to p_quote_date + 2 (no calendar adjustment).

open_questions: Is the age()-based month count in v_left (lines 62-64) the intended definition of 'last 3 months of the tenor'?
Should missing benchmark_rate rows produce rate 0 (line 49) or raise an error?
Is treating missing day_count as 360 (line 56) the desired fallback?
Confirm that no holiday or calendar adjustment is required for the +2 day validity (line 72).
